description:
Brand Introduction

Swedish Wilderness Adventures is a leading provider of sustainable and authentic nature experiences in Jämtland, Sweden. We specialize in offering unique adventures that connect visitors with Sweden's pristine wilderness. Our offerings include hiking tours, fishing expeditions, northern lights safaris, and luxury accommodations in untouched natural settings. With a focus on sustainability and adventure, we aim to create unforgettable experiences for travelers who value nature and environmental conservation.

Product Description

Our diverse range of sustainable travel packages caters to families, nature enthusiasts, and adventure seekers. Some of our key offerings include:

  • Guided hiking tours through Sweden's national parks, showcasing breathtaking landscapes.
  • Northern lights safaris for an awe-inspiring view of the Aurora Borealis.
  • Fishing adventures in unspoiled lakes and rivers, perfect for beginners and experts alike.
  • Luxury accommodations that blend seamlessly with the natural surroundings, offering both comfort and tranquility.

Every experience is designed to balance relaxation and excitement while minimizing environmental impact.

Unique Selling Points (USPs)

  • Sustainability Focus: Every activity is designed to minimize ecological footprints, ensuring harmony with nature.
  • Authentic Wilderness Experiences: Immerse yourself in Sweden’s untouched landscapes.
  • Customizable Adventures: Packages tailored to meet the individual preferences of each traveler.
  • Premium Quality and Safety: Professional guides, top-tier equipment, and a commitment to customer safety.

Payment Terms

Earn up to 7% commission on referral sales!

Order Value Commission Amount
Level 1: 0 – 20 000 kr 5%
Level 2: 25 001 kr + 7%

How it works:

  • Orders between 0 and 20,000 kr: Earn 5% commission.
  • Orders above 25,001 kr: Earn 7% commission.

All sales made through your affiliate link or coupon code will contribute to your earnings.

Target Audience

  • Nature Enthusiasts: Individuals who love the outdoors and are drawn to authentic, sustainable experiences.
  • High-Income Travelers: Tourists seeking unique and premium adventures.
  • Families: Groups looking for enriching and memorable holiday experiences in nature.

Seasonality

  • High demand during summer and winter seasons, when activities like hiking, fishing, and northern lights safaris are most popular.

Affiliate Support

We provide comprehensive support to help affiliates maximize their success:

  • Marketing Materials: Images, and content to support your promotions.
  • Special Promotions: Exclusive campaigns and discounts to boost conversions.
